description: E3b arm B -- refinement at 5 blocks
observations: A refinement stack trained at 5 residual blocks matches six-block H2 at the same budget, seed and recipe, and stays stereo-functional.

160 training scenes from random initialisation: a capacity result here does NOT transfer to a pretrained model. MACs are arithmetic, not latency (Phase 1 measured 0.67x-142x misprediction on this stack). One seed in stage 1; no significance test and none claimed.
Stereo dependence is RECORDED at epochs 10 and 100 and JUDGED only at epoch 200 -- never gated before epoch 20, per EXP-H2-EMERGENCE-001.
conclusion: Arm B (5 blocks): 200 epochs; late-window EPE 4.293098435132986 D1 29.75378138709778; matching gradient 100.0% of 16000 batches; no abort.
